tool_input.command: /runtime/node --version && sed -n '1,260p' src/session.js && sed -n '1,220p' package.json && sed -n '1,240p' README.md

/runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {Session} from './src/session.js'; const flush=()=>Promise.resolve().then(()=>Promise.resolve()); let calls=0; const fresh=new Session({queryFn:({signal})=>{calls++;void signal;return 'x'},timers:{schedule:f=>f() }},{online:false}); const h=fresh.subscribe('fresh'); fresh.unsubscribe(h); fresh.online(true); await flush(); assert.equal(calls,0); assert.deepEqual(fresh.snapshot('fresh'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'idle',data:null}); fresh.subscribe('fresh'); await flush(); assert.equal(calls,1); let queued=0; const race=new Session({queryFn:()=>{queued++;return 'y'},timers:{schedule:f=>f()}},{online:false}); const hr=race.subscribe('race'); race.online(true); race.unsubscribe(hr); await flush(); assert.equal(queued,0); let release; let started=0; const active=new Session({queryFn:()=>{started++;return new Promise(r=>release=r)},timers:{schedule:f=>f()}}); const ha=active.subscribe('active'); active.unsubscribe(ha); release('done'); await flush(); assert.equal(started,1); assert.equal(active.snapshot('active').data,'done'); let phase=0; const cached=new Session({queryFn:()=>++phase===1?'old':'new',timers:{schedule:f=>f()}}); const hc=cached.subscribe('cached'); await flush(); cached.unsubscribe(hc); cached.online(false); const hd=cached.subscribe('cached'); cached.unsubscribe(hd); cached.online(true); await flush(); assert.equal(cached.snapshot('cached').data,'new'); console.log('lifecycle assertions passed')"
git diff --check && git diff -- src/session.js && git status --short

/runtime/node --check src/session.js && /runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import {Session} from './src/session.js'; const flush=()=>Promise.resolve().then(()=>Promise.resolve()); let aborted=false, starts=0; let finish; const s=new Session({queryFn:({signal})=>{starts++; signal.addEventListener('abort',()=>aborted=true); return new Promise(r=>finish=r)},timers:{schedule:f=>f()}}); const a=s.subscribe('shared'),b=s.subscribe('shared'); s.unsubscribe(a); assert.equal(aborted,false); s.unsubscribe(b); assert.equal(aborted,true); finish('late'); await flush(); assert.deepEqual(s.snapshot('shared'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'idle',data:null}); let shared=0; let resolve; const u=new Session({queryFn:()=>{shared++;return new Promise(r=>resolve=r)},timers:{schedule:f=>f()}}); const x=u.subscribe('x'),y=u.subscribe('x'); assert.equal(shared,1); u.unsubscribe(x); resolve('ok'); await flush(); assert.equal(u.snapshot('x').data,'ok'); u.unsubscribe(y); console.log('syntax and cancellation/shared-observer assertions passed')" && sed -n '1,120p' src/session.js

/runtime/node --check src/session.js && /runtime/node --input-type=module -e "import assert from 'node:assert/strict';import {Session} from './src/session.js';let calls=0;const s=new Session({queryFn:({signal})=>{calls++;void signal;return 1},timers:{schedule:f=>f()}},{online:false});const h=s.subscribe('stop');s.online(true);s.unsubscribe(h);await Promise.resolve();await Promise.resolve();assert.equal(calls,0);assert.deepEqual(s.snapshot('stop'),{status:'pending',fetchStatus:'idle',data:null});console.log('final regression passed')"
